Public SwapBegin tail-calls object function pointer +4e0 if object/pointer nonnull, otherwise returns e00002c2. Backend selection is not re-proven in this bounded inspection.

Named kern_SwapBegin calls IOConnectCallScalarMethod selector4, zero scalar inputs and output capacity1. Error maps to e00002bc without output store. Success copies low32 scalar output to object+58 and caller output pointer if nonnull, then returns0.
Named kern_SwapEnd passes object+18 length0x264 to IOConnectCallStructMethod selector5, retaining return status.
finish_update calls public SwapEnd and checks return W20; zero continues normal finish path, nonzero enters error path.

finish_update_ stores current self+29c index into self+2a0 and advances/wraps self+29c using count+2a4. This identifies excluded index as most recently finished slot, without proving current physical scanout.
can_update passes retained ring token to SwapWait and clears it only on zero-return path.

interpretation: Ring token is an allocated SwapBegin output retained across submission/wait, not a CPU-generated loop counter or proof of completed fence. Its generation precedes SwapEnd. Healthy84 token468..472 population therefore fits successive allocated/reused slots, but captures do not pair tokens with submissions or final returns. Frozen76/82 stationary tokens alone cannot distinguish no new allocation from retained-token reuse or downstream completion state.
